statement.zh: 若将法尤姆新石器直接等同「尼罗河国家唯一摇篮」，会过度简化；《Desert Fayum》记录的是北法尤姆新石器生计与石器组合，不是古王国国家制度专报。
statement.en: Equating Fayum Neolithic directly with the sole cradle of the Nile state oversimplifies; The Desert Fayum records northern Fayum Neolithic subsistence and lithics, not Old Kingdom state institutions.

disclaimer: Hypothesis: regional Neolithic ≠ automatic state origin narrative; keep Fayum evidence scoped to the 1934 report.

editorial.notes: Density pass 4; contested material kept as hypothesis where applicable.
